properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued July 24 at 3:12PM HST until July 25 at 6:00PM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
properties.description:
...HIGH SURF ADVISORY FOR SOUTH FACING SHORES THROUGH SATURDAY...

.A long-period south-southwest swell continues to produce advisory
level surf along south-facing shores this afternoon. The swell
declines tonight, which may cause surf to briefly fall below
advisory levels late tonight or early on Saturday. Then, a
reinforcing pulse of long- period south-southwest energy arrives,
which is expected to bring surf back to advisory level by
Saturday afternoon and possibly continuing through the weekend.

* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 7 to 10 feet.

* WHERE...South facing shores of all Hawaiian Islands.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM HST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate. Strong breaking waves and strong currents
will make swimming dangerous.
properties.instruction:
Heed all advice from ocean safety officials. When in doubt, don't
go out.

NWSheadline: HIGH SURF ADVISORY NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 6 PM HST SATURDAY
